package entity

type Parent struct {
 Id string `gorm:"primaryKey"`
 Profile *Profile `gorm:"foreignKey:ParentID"`
 Settings *Settings `gorm:"foreignKey:ParentID"`
 Children []*Child `gorm:"foreignKey:ParentID"`
 Notes []*Note `gorm:"foreignKey:ParentID"`
 Details map[string]string `gorm:"serializer:json"`
 JSONEntity *Snapshot `db:"json_entity,json"`
 JSONEntities ParentSnapshots `db:"json_entities,json"`
}

type Profile struct { Id string `gorm:"primaryKey"`; ParentID string; Name string }
type Settings struct { Id string `gorm:"primaryKey"`; ParentID string; Theme string }
type Child struct { Id string `gorm:"primaryKey"`; ParentID string; Name string }
type Note struct { Id string `gorm:"primaryKey"`; ParentID string; Text string }
type Plain struct { Id string `gorm:"primaryKey"`; Name string }
type Snapshot struct { Id string `gorm:"primaryKey"`; Label string }
type ParentSnapshots []*Snapshot
